from models import Address, BillingAddress, Invoice, InvoiceItem, InvoiceLine, InvoiceRecord


def map_invoice_record_to_invoice(source: InvoiceRecord) -> Invoice:
    return Invoice(
        # TODO: no value for "id" in the mapping
        id="",
        issued_at=source.issued_at,
        due_date=source.due_date,
        status=source.status,
        total=source.total,
        currency=source.currency,
        notes=source.notes,
        customer_id=source.customer.customer_id,
        # TODO: no value for "customerName" in the mapping
        customer_name="",
        customer_email=source.customer.email,
        # TODO: the source may be missing, but "billingAddress" is required
        billing_address=map_billing_address_to_address(source.customer.billing_address) if source.customer.billing_address is not None else None,
        # TODO: the source may be missing, but "items" is required
        items=[map_invoice_line_to_invoice_item(item) for item in source.lines] if source.lines is not None else None,
        # TODO: the source may be missing, but "isPaid" is required
        is_paid=source.paid,
        # TODO: no value for "createdBy" in the mapping
        created_by="",
    )


def map_billing_address_to_address(source: BillingAddress) -> Address:
    return Address(
        street=source.street,
        city=source.city,
        postal_code=source.zip_code,
        # TODO: the source may be missing, but "countryCode" is required
        country_code=source.country,
    )


def map_invoice_line_to_invoice_item(source: InvoiceLine) -> InvoiceItem:
    return InvoiceItem(
        sku=source.sku,
        description=source.description,
        quantity=source.quantity,
        unit_price=source.unit_price,
        # TODO: the source may be missing, but "taxRate" is required
        tax_rate=source.tax_rate if source.tax_rate is not None else None,

fun InvoiceRecord.toInvoice(): Invoice = Invoice(
    id = TODO("No value for id in the mapping"),
    issuedAt = issuedAt,
    dueDate = dueDate,
    status = status,
    total = total,
    currency = currency,
    notes = notes,
    customerId = customer.customerId,
    customerName = TODO("No value for customerName in the mapping"),
    customerEmail = customer.email,
    billingAddress = requireNotNull(customer.billingAddress?.let { value -> value.toAddress() }) { "A required value is missing in the source" },

    isPaid = requireNotNull(paid) { "A required value is missing in the source" },
    createdBy = TODO("No value for createdBy in the mapping"),
)

    city = city,

)

    sku = sku,
    description = description,
    quantity = quantity.toInt(),
    unitPrice = unitPrice,
    taxRate = requireNotNull(taxRate?.let { value -> value.toDouble() }) { "A required value is missing in the source" },
)

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

final class InvoiceRecordMapper
{
    public static function toInvoice(InvoiceRecord $source): Invoice
    {
        return new Invoice(
            id: throw new \LogicException('No value for id in the mapping'),
            issuedAt: $source->issuedAt,
            dueDate: $source->dueDate,
            status: $source->status,
            total: $source->total,
            currency: $source->currency,
            notes: $source->notes,
            customerId: $source->customer->customerId,
            customerName: throw new \LogicException('No value for customerName in the mapping'),
            customerEmail: $source->customer->email,
            billingAddress: $source->customer->billingAddress === null ? null : self::toAddress($source->customer->billingAddress) ?? throw new \InvalidArgumentException('A required value is missing in the source.'),
            items: $source->lines === null ? null : array_map(self::toInvoiceItem(...), $source->lines) ?? throw new \InvalidArgumentException('A required value is missing in the source.'),
            isPaid: $source->paid ?? throw new \InvalidArgumentException('A required value is missing in the source.'),
            createdBy: throw new \LogicException('No value for createdBy in the mapping'),
        );
    }

    public static function toAddress(BillingAddress $source): Address
    {
        return new Address(
            street: $source->street,
            city: $source->city,
            postalCode: $source->zipCode,
            countryCode: $source->country ?? throw new \InvalidArgumentException('A required value is missing in the source.'),
        );
    }

    public static function toInvoiceItem(InvoiceLine $source): InvoiceItem
    {
        return new InvoiceItem(
            sku: $source->sku,
            description: $source->description,
            quantity: $source->quantity,
            unitPrice: $source->unitPrice,
            taxRate: $source->taxRate === null ? null : $source->taxRate ?? throw new \InvalidArgumentException('A required value is missing in the source.'),
        );
    }
}
